title: Pandolfi's teenage metallurgical analysis of a Glomar Explorer piece

tellings.quote: >> Well, that's that's another story. The story was that his father gave him a piece that he was they were involved with the uh uh Glowar Explorer.

plain: As a teenager, a man named Ron Pandolfi is said to have run a metal analysis on a piece his father gave him, a piece tied to the Glomar Explorer, a ship his father's people were involved with. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron passes this on to Michels as something he was told, calling it "another story" and giving it only briefly. The tale suggests Pandolfi was handling unusual hardware from an early age.
